Write a polynomial-time reduction from Vertex Cover to Clique. problems.py defines both problems: SOURCE is Vertex Cover and TARGET is Clique. The SOURCE and TARGET class docstrings give the exact instance formats, yes-conditions and edge cases.

SOURCE = VertexCover
Vertex Cover.

Instance: {"n": n, "edges": [[u, v], ...], "k": k}
  * Vertices are 0..n-1. Edges are undirected pairs [u, v] with u != v;
    [u, v] and [v, u] are the same edge and may not both appear.
  * k is any integer.

Yes iff the graph has a vertex cover of AT MOST k vertices: a set of
vertices that includes at least one endpoint of every edge.

Edge cases: k < 0 is always no. A graph with no edges is yes for every
k >= 0 (the empty set covers it). k >= n is yes, since all vertices cover
every edge.

TARGET = Clique
Clique.

Instance: {"n": n, "edges": [[u, v], ...], "k": k}
  * Vertices are 0..n-1. Edges are undirected pairs [u, v] with u != v;
    [u, v] and [v, u] are the same edge and may not both appear.
  * k is any integer.

Yes iff the graph has a clique of AT LEAST k vertices: k vertices with an
edge between every two of them.

Edge cases: k <= 0 is always yes. k = 1 is yes whenever n >= 1. k > n is
always no.

WORKING DIRECTORY: /tmp/reduction-kdksrfz7

actions.command:
cat <<'EOF' > reduce.py
"""Polynomial-time reduction from Vertex Cover to Clique.

Given a Vertex Cover instance G = (V, E) and integer k, construct the
complement graph H = (V, complement(E)) and set k' = n - k.

A set C is a vertex cover of G iff V \ C is a clique in H.  Therefore G has
a vertex cover of size at most k iff H has a clique of size at least n - k.
The construction runs in O(n^2) time.
"""


def reduce(instance):
    n = instance["n"]
    k = instance["k"]

    # Normalize the source edges so lookups are orientation-independent.
    source_edges = set()
    for edge in instance.get("edges", []):
        u, v = edge
        if u > v:
            u, v = v, u
        source_edges.add((u, v))

    # Build the complement graph on the same vertex set.
    complement_edges = []
    for u in range(n):
        for v in range(u + 1, n):
            if (u, v) not in source_edges:
                complement_edges.append([u, v])

    return {"n": n, "edges": complement_edges, "k": n - k}
EOF

"""Polynomial-time reduction from Vertex Cover to Clique.

Given a Vertex Cover instance G = (V, E) and integer k, construct the
complement graph H = (V, complement(E)) and set k' = n - k.

A set C is a vertex cover of G iff V \ C is a clique in H.  Therefore G has
a vertex cover of size at most k iff H has a clique of size at least n - k.
The construction runs in O(n^2) time.
"""


def reduce(instance):
    n = instance["n"]
    k = instance["k"]

    # Normalize the source edges so lookups are orientation-independent.
    source_edges = set()
    for edge in instance.get("edges", []):
        u, v = edge
        if u > v:
            u, v = v, u
        source_edges.add((u, v))

    # Build the complement graph on the same vertex set.
    complement_edges = []
    for u in range(n):
        for v in range(u + 1, n):
            if (u, v) not in source_edges:
                complement_edges.append([u, v])

    return {"n": n, "edges": complement_edges, "k": n - k}

def validate_graph(instance: Instance) -> None:
